ELAPSE / SCENE STUDY 03

South Tower impact · Scene study

Geometry · camera · effects study

An educational scene based on official records of the South Tower impact. Aircraft details, approach, camera, flames, smoke, debris and pacing are estimates; actual speed and impact mechanics are not simulated. Nearby buildings are estimated contextual massing. No people or victims are depicted. This study also informs the two impacts and three collapses in the full timeline.
